fieldTypeContract.text: Stored string; text input; length/pattern validation; searchable only when configured.
fieldTypeContract.textarea: Stored string; multiline input; length/content validation; usually searchable, not faceted.
fieldTypeContract.number: Stored number; numeric input; min/max/unit validation; exact or range filtering.
fieldTypeContract.boolean: Stored boolean; toggle/checkbox; true/false validation; yes/no facet.
fieldTypeContract.enum: Stored stable key; select/radio/chips; value must match values array; facet filter.
fieldTypeContract.multi_enum: Stored array of stable keys; checklist UI; each key must match values array; multi-select facet if configured.
fieldTypeContract.enum_or_text: Stored known key or custom string; select with custom fallback; known values faceted, custom values searchable.
fieldTypeContract.enum_or_number: Stored known key or number; select plus numeric fallback; known values faceted or numeric range.
fieldTypeContract.range: Search-control range object or paired params; not a listing detail by default.
fieldTypeContract.date: Stored ISO date; date input; date/range filtering.
fieldTypeContract.ref: Stored referenced ID; picker/search select; reference must resolve when enforced.
fieldTypeContract.note: Research/admin metadata only; never user-editable or filterable.
